hook: orphan 混裝｜A區清倉籃：把還在主庫晃蕩的 orphan 裝進籃子，標籤要用中文義核。
script: abandon/abjudicate/absolute/abstemious 先入籃。清倉廣播：這不是亂打折，是差集點名；每個詞報到時大聲念釋義，防止魚目混珠。

members.senseAnchor: to withdraw from often in the face of danger or encroachment
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-v. 放: abandon walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-v. 放」出場：abandon 一上場梗就黏住——v. 放棄。

members.senseAnchor: a GRE-level vocabulary item meaning closely related to its core sense in academic English
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-裁定；判: abjudicate walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-裁定；判」出場：abjudicate 一上場梗就黏住——裁定；判決。

members.senseAnchor: something that is conceived or that exists independently and not in relation to other things; something that does not depend on anything else and is beyond human control; something that is not relative; perfect or complete or pure
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-絕對的/: absolute walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-絕對的/」出場：absolute 一上場梗就黏住——絕對的/獨裁的。

related.synonyms: downright, out-and-out, rank, right-down, sheer, infrangible

members.senseAnchor: not eating or drinking too much
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-adj.: abstemious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-adj.」出場：abstemious 一上場梗就黏住——adj. 有節制的。

members.senseAnchor: the trait of abstaining (especially from alcohol)
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-剋制的；: abstention walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-剋制的；」出場：abstention 一上場梗就黏住——剋制的；節制的。

members.senseAnchor: self-restraining; not indulging an appetite especially for food or drink

members.speakLineZh: 請「席-有節制的」出場：abstentious 一上場梗就黏住——有節制的；剋制的。

members.senseAnchor: a person who refrains from drinking intoxicating beverages; self-restraining; not indulging an appetite especially for food or drink

members.speakLineZh: 請「席-剋制的；」出場：abstinent 一上場梗就黏住——剋制的；禁慾的。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 席-無果實的: acarpous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「席-無果實的」出場：acarpous 一上場梗就黏住——無果實的。

members.senseAnchor: clothing that is worn or carried, but not part of your main clothing; a supplementary component that improves capability
